newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Citicorp, Chase estimates cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Citicorp, Chase estimates cut.

text.p: -- Sanford C. Bernstein analyst Ronald Mandle cut the 1997 estimate on Citicorp Wednesday to $8.50 per share from $8.60 and cut the 1998 estimate to $9.60 from $9.75, a Wall Street source said
-- The source said Mandle also cut estimates on Chase Manhattan Corp, dropping the 1997 estimate to $8.50 per share from $8.75 and cutting 1998 to $10.30 from 10.60
-- The ratings remain market perform for Citicorp and outperform for Chase Manhattan
-- Both companies reported first-quarter earnings Tuesday which were close to consenus estimates.
